name: sort-menu
title: Sort Menu
description: The one-key sort: the fields, then the two directions worded by field type (Oldest first, A → Z, Low → high), with Reset while not at the page default.

meta.whenToUse: Sorting a list by one key from the ListToolbar's Sort tool.
meta.whenNotToUse: Several sort keys at once (SortBuilder), or a column header's own sort.
